mintAuthority.summary: FXD is minted from collateralized debt positions on XDC; the StablecoinAdapter proxy (0xe3b248) holds MINTER_ROLE on the FXD token. Both the FXD token proxy and the StablecoinAdapter proxy are managed by a single ProxyAdmin (0xb82ad475) whose owner is EOA 0x594d425a. The former DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE membership-count assertion is not reproduced by the non-enumerable implementation. The EOA can unilaterally upgrade the FXD token and StablecoinAdapter logic, making this concentrated-admin.
